name: account-review
title: Account attribution evidence review
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM accounts ORDER BY code

sections.title: Account purpose and ownership
sections.sql: SELECT code,name,owner,purpose,review_due FROM accounts WHERE id=$1

sections.title: Deals
sections.sql: SELECT code,name,status,currency,amount_cents,closed_on FROM deals WHERE account_id=$1 ORDER BY code

sections.title: Journey evidence
sections.sql: SELECT external_id,occurred_on,channel,verified,retention_due FROM touches WHERE account_id=$1 ORDER BY occurred_on,external_id

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.sql: SELECT code,name,owner,due_on,status FROM actions WHERE account_id=$1 ORDER BY code

name: deal-credit
title: Deal credit reconciliation
for_each: SELECT id,code FROM deals WHERE status='won' ORDER BY code

sections.title: Eligible credit allocation
sections.note: An empty result means unallocated revenue, not zero revenue. These models allocate credit; they do not establish causality.
sections.sql: SELECT channel,occurred_on,currency,first_cents,last_cents,linear_cents FROM attribution_credit WHERE deal_id=$1 ORDER BY ordinal
